program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = min(r for r, c in marks)
    left = min(c for r, c in marks)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in marks]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1, max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - sh + 1):
        for c in range(w - sw + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = 8
    return out
'''
